title: Eternals Explained: Why Did Marvel Send Ten Gods to Earth?
description:
Why do ten Eternals come to Earth, and why does their story end with a giant hand rising from the sea? Gabe (Slick Dissident) connects those images through yod, the Hebrew letter associated with a hand and the number ten. We put the team on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, compare Arishem’s plan to the myth of the cosmic egg, and ask what became of the old gods when superheroes took their place.

description:
